## Root cause
Classification: **D. POR_SPECIFIC_PROTOCOL_MISMATCH**.

The archived frozen POR final runner calls `fit_uci_model_v5_1(... imbalance_strategy=str(selected["imbalance"]))`. The isolated NONE adapter correctly forces NONE for this sensitivity control, but the frozen selected recipe for outer fold 1 is `class_weight`. Therefore the comparison is not an exact reproduction of the frozen authority. The slight metric delta cannot be attributed solely to nondeterminism, so a post-hoc `<0.001` tolerance is not scientifically defensible. MAT passes because its shared-subject transfer final path does not consume the selected imbalance argument.

No frozen authority or completed run artifact was modified; no further training was launched.
